events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was shot dead in Las Vegas at the age of 25.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Remembering a true icon of hip-hop today. Tupac Shakur's music and legacy continue to resonate, decades after his untimely passing.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work changed music forever.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Memories
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. What's your favourite track from this legendary album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Rock on, legend.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic album 'Imagine' in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon released the timeless album 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates as strongly as ever.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod in 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember when the first iPod dropped in 2001? It completely transformed our music experience. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, what's your favourite Bond moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled the 'White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. What are your standout tracks?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Forever
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Reflection
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that marked a significant shift in their sound.

events.title: John Lennon's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the life and music of John Lennon, who passed away on this day in 1980 at the age of 40.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost a musical visionary. John Lennon's message of peace and love lives on through his timeless songs.
